command.name: security key-manager external gcp disable
command.description: This command disables the Google Cloud Key Management Service (GCKMS) associated with the given Vserver. GCKMS cannot be disabled if it is in use by ONTAP. This command will fail if GCKMS has not been enabled for the Vserver.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the Vserver on which the GCKMS is to be disabled.

example.p: The following example disables the GCKMS for Vserver v1.
example.screen: cluster-1::>security key-manager external gcp disable -vserver v1
